evidence: Clicking "New Resume" created a new "Untitled Resume" with all empty Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills fields, ready for editing.
Template tab offers 3 preset styles (Modern, Classic, Minimal); selecting one instantly re-styles the live preview. Seeded resumes also each carry a distinct preset template (minimal/classic/modern).

Successfully entered/edited Contact (name, email, phone, location, LinkedIn, website), Summary, Experience (company/title/dates/description), Education (institution/degree/field/dates/GPA), and Skills (name+level) — all reflected correctly.
In Sections tab, renamed "Work Experience" heading to "Career History" and moved "Education" section above it using the up-arrow reorder control; both changes applied immediately in the live preview.
Live Preview panel renders the resume as edited; "Hide Preview"/"Show Preview" toggle button correctly hides and restores the preview panel.
Card menu "Duplicate" created "QA Test Resume (Copy)"; "Rename" opened a dialog and successfully renamed it to "QA Test Resume - Job Application 2", reflected on the list.
Multiple distinct resume versions (new blank resume, its duplicate, and 3 seeded resumes) coexisted in the "Your Resumes" list simultaneously, each independently editable.

Search box filtering "Marketing" correctly narrowed list to only "Marketing Manager Resume". Sort combobox offers Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A; selecting "Title A-Z" correctly re-ordered the list alphabetically.

issue: No validation of experience/education time frame validity or conflicts
actual: Added a second Experience entry with Start Date 2021-06 and End Date 2020-01 (end before start, an impossible time frame) — the app accepted it silently, rendering "Jun 2021 - Jan 2020" in the preview with no error/warning. Also tested overlapping periods (2020-01–2022-06 vs 2021-01–2021-12) between two experience entries; both were accepted with no conflict warning.

evidence: Start Date/End Date fields are native HTML5 <input type="month"> elements. Attempting to fill a non-conforming value (e.g. "not-a-date") is rejected by the browser itself ("Malformed value" error), so only valid YYYY-MM values can be entered, enforcing correct time format.

issue: Saved resume data is not persisted across page reload
actual: Created "QA Test Resume" and its duplicate/rename "QA Test Resume - Job Application 2", both visible in the resume list before reload. After navigating to http://localhost:7005/ again (full reload), both custom resumes disappeared entirely — only the 3 original seeded resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer) remained. Data exists only in-memory, not persistently stored.

evidence: Every edit (contact fields, summary, experience, education, skills, template switch, section reorder/rename) was reflected in the Live Preview panel immediately upon the next snapshot, with no stale or incorrect content observed.
Renaming "Work Experience" to "Career History" and moving Education above it via the reorder arrow both took effect instantly in the live preview with no reload or delay.

issue: No user-facing feedback/confirmation shown after saving
actual: There is no explicit "Save" action for resume content (it auto-saves to memory); throughout editing, renaming (via dialog "Save" button), navigating back to the list, etc., the "Notifications" region remained an empty list at every check — no toast, banner, or confirmation message ever appeared to indicate a successful save.

evidence: Modern, Classic templates rendered complete resume layouts (header, summary, experience, education, skills) with no truncation or overlap; the content-rich seeded "Marketing Manager Resume" (2 experience entries, 2 education entries, 5 skills) also rendered fully without layout issues.

All entered fields (Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, LinkedIn, Website, Summary, Experience company/title/dates/description, Education institution/degree/field/dates/GPA, Skills) were retained and correctly displayed in both the form and preview across tab switches.

After duplicating "QA Test Resume" and changing the Full Name field in the copy to "Timothee Issenmann (Copy Version)", the original "QA Test Resume" still showed unchanged "Timothee Issenmann" — confirming independent, non-shared data storage between versions.

Resume titles matched consistently between the resume list card heading and the editor page header/title button (e.g. "QA Test Resume - Job Application 2" appeared identically in both places after renaming).
